The new iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max are now available for pre-order. Apple unveiled the new phones on Wednesday, featuring a variable aperture camera system, a smaller Dynamic Island, and four new colour options.

  • Pre-order iPhone 18 Pro from Apple
  • Pre-order iPhone 18 Pro Max from Apple
  • Pre-order iPhone 18 Pro from Walmart
  • Pre-order iPhone 18 Pro Max from Walmart

You can now pre-order the iPhone 18 Pro

Here's a quick refresher on some of the iPhone 18 Pro lineup's standout features:

  • A new variable aperture main camera for finer control over light and depth of field.
  • A new A20 Pro chip with 50% more memory bandwidth and 40% faster GPU performance.
  • A smaller Dynamic Island that can now display three Live Activities simultaneously.
  • A major battery life boost. The iPhone 18 Pro can last up to 24 hours of real-world use, while the iPhone 18 Pro Max stretches to 30 hours.
  • A new vapor chamber thermal design for better sustained performance.
  • Faster wired charging: 15 minutes to reach 50%.

The iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max come in four colours:

  • Burgundy
  • Glacier Blue
  • Silver
  • Black

The iPhone 18 Pro starts at $1,199, while the iPhone 18 Pro Max begins at $1,299. Storage kicks off at 256GB and goes up to 2TB. Purchase options include outright payment, instalments via Apple Card or carriers, and the new Apple Upgrade leasing programme.

The first batch of iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max pre-orders will arrive next Friday, September 18. The next pre-order window opens for the iPhone Duo on October 16, with shipping starting October 23.

Are you planning to pre-order the iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max? Or are you waiting for the iPhone Duo? Let us know in the comments.
